title: Asset library in the bible
caption: A new Asset library page in the local bible lists the 162 world pieces the game builds in code. Each one has pictures of its variants, every file and line that uses it, and how to call it. Each outdoor piece is marked street style or old faceted, and one table shows what the street style still lacks, family by family. A second list shows the 22 kinds of thing the audit found built in more than one place. Open it at http://127.0.0.1:8771/bible/#assets.

sections.title: The library
sections.caption: Pieces are grouped by family: building parts, street furniture, planting, ground, lighting, materials, interior props and helpers. You can filter by family, by place or by look, or show only the pieces that are also built elsewhere.

sections.title: Street style and faceted
sections.caption: The street style only exists for the forecourt so far. 24 pieces are street style. 16 old faceted pieces have a street version that only runs in the forecourt, and 41 have none yet; that column is what the world kit builds next, each with a lighter phone version. A street piece's page says where it works and how it gets lighter on a phone, and a faceted piece's page links its street version if it has one.

sections.title: One piece
sections.caption: A piece's page shows its variants, how to call it, the copies the audit found elsewhere, and every place that uses it, with links to the lines.
